tools.name: get_permit_record
tools.description: Fetch one accommodation permit record from official government data. For Korea: by its government management number (e.g. AGCV065100002024000451), optionally with its Korean issuing region, or by registered business name together with the Korean issuing region (e.g. name 'Jobs', region '서울특별시 종로구').

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_permit_record · Private data: verify_listing_registration, get_permit_record · Public sink: verify_listing_registration.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_permit_record · Private data: verify_listing_registration, get_permit_record · Public sink: verify_listing_registration

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "verify_listing_registration" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
